Cambridge Science Festival
The
Cambridge Science Festival
was a series of events typically held annually in March in
Cambridge
,
England
and was the United Kingdom's largest free
science festival
.
[
1
]
In 2019 it was announced that the Cambridge Science Festival and the Cambridge Festival of Ideas would be combined into one festival. The
Cambridge Festival
took place for the first time in March 2021.
The festival attracts more than 30,000 visitors to over 250 events.
[
2
]
University researchers and students open their lecture halls and laboratories to the general public, and hold Talks, Exhibitions and Demonstrations, mostly free of charge.
[
1
]
Started in 1994 by scientists of the
University of Cambridge
and backed by local businesses, the festival was inspired by
National Science Week
and is aimed making science and engineering more accessible, showcasing research performed at Cambridge University, and encouraging young people to pursue careers in engineering and science.
